title: Fate's Move
next_chapter_hook: The Sect Master's body swelled and cracked from the forbidden backlash, yet within that crumbling shell, something was slowly opening its eyes—something far more ancient and more forbidden than the Heavenly Dao's Eye.

text.content: Blood dripped from Su Qingyao's collar, spreading a shocking red flower across the blue stone ground. Her gaze pierced through the layers of battle fire, firmly locked onto Chen Ji—three years of pursuit, three years of protection, finally finding an answer in this moment. And that answer stood at the heart of fate in a posture she had never seen before.

In the instant Chen Ji felt that gaze, something in his chest shattered. He remembered that rainy night three years ago, when this proud woman first questioned histrash person—no, histrash persona. He recalled her stubborn persistence, repeatedly hitting dead ends in his schemes yet never abandoning her investigation. And more vividly, those tender moments he had deliberately avoided.

He didn't wait for her response. His right hand reached into his怀里, retrieving the piece that the Tianji Record had nurtured for three years—Number Forty-Nine, the core of the Fate Chess Game. The flowing patterns on the piece matched the Tianji Record Fragment perfectly, now trembling at some indescribable frequency, as if sensing his suppressed three-year fury.

Ling Yuan's wild laughter echoed across the plaza. The forbidden formation beneath his feet had fully unfolded, torrential demonic energy transforming into substantial chains spreading in all directions. "Chen Ji? You think a single incomplete Tianji Record can oppose me?" He gazed down at the ant-like youth. "You're merely an abandoned piece chosen by the Heavenly Dao, while I am the true chess player!"

Chen Ji raised his head. Those eyes that usually hid cowardice and evasion were now crystal clear, almost transparent. He didn't refute. Slowly, he pressed the Forty-Nine piece onto the earth beneath his feet. In that instant, from the piece as the center, mysterious patterns spread in all directions like the threads of fate, cutting the entire battlefield into the shape of a chessboard.

Wherever the patterns passed, the demonic energy of the forbidden formation was suppressed by three inches. Ling Yuan's expression changed slightly; his formation spun faster, attempting to resist that strange power. But he didn't know—this was merely the beginning. Chen Ji closed his eyes as the Tianji Record Fragment turned to a new page in his mind—the page where Mo Xiansheng, for the first time, took the initiative to manifest.

dialogue.content: Good, very good. Three years, and you finally decided to use this piece. The cost is thirty points of Heavenly Fate, plus... the thread of karma between you and her.

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul issued a warning: using the Forty-Nine piece would consume thirty points of Heavenly Fate and sever the karmic connection between Chen Ji and Su Qingyao—this meant she would never be able to perceive his true identity again. Accept the cost, or find another way?

choices.text: Sever karmic ties, exchange for her eternal peace
choices.description: Sacrifice the special connection with Su Qingyao, ensuring she will no longer be drawn into this chess game, forcibly drive the Fate Chess Game with Heavenly Fate.
choices.visible_cost: Heavenly Fate -30, karmic severance (Su Qingyao will lose the ability to perceive Chen Ji)
choices.visible_reward: Fate Chess Game fully unfolds, covering the entire battlefield
choices.risk_hint: Losing the bond with Su Qingyao, she may be unable to understand Chen Ji's true identity in the future

text.content: Chen Ji didn't hesitate. Heavenly Fate could be accumulated again, karma could be renewed, but if Su Qingyao died because of him, that would be the greatest failure in his calculated life. The thirty points of Heavenly Fate were instantly extracted from his body, the sensation like having flesh gouged from his heart. He grunted, a trickle of blood escaping his lips.

dialogue.content: A move made cannot be taken back.

choices.text: Preserve karma, find flaws then strike
choices.description: Without using the complete chess game, instead use the fragmentary power to find Ling Yuan's weakness, trading minimum cost for maximum gain.
choices.visible_cost: Battle time extends, Su Qingyao may be injured again
choices.visible_reward: Preserving karmic connection with Su Qingyao may trigger deeper bond events
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan's forbidden formation power continues to increase, potentially causing greater casualties

text.content: Chen Ji narrowed his eyes as the Forty-Nine piece rotated in his palm. He was calculating—not the outcome, but the casualties. If he forcibly activated the complete chess game now, Su Qingyao would lose her perception of him; but if he waited, her injuries would worsen.

dialogue.content: Wait a bit longer... the flaw is about to appear.

text.content: The Fate Chessboard fully unfolded under Chen Ji's urging. Black patterns like living things writhed across the ground, dividing the battlefield into a massive chessboard of nineteen lines. Every intersection was a node of fate, every line leading to an unknown outcome. The forbidden formation beneath Ling Yuan's feet was invaded by the chessboard's power, letting out a piercing shriek.

At this moment, in the heavens above, something stirred. The Heavenly Dao's Eye—that enormous pupil that had been coldly watching the battlefield—unexpectedly contracted for an instant. Then, a transcendent will descended from the Nine Heavens. It wasn't the Heavenly Dao's Eye itself, but something far more ancient and powerful.

Just these two words plunged the entire battlefield into deathly silence. The voice didn't enter through the ears but resounded directly in everyone's soul. Ling Yuan's forbidden formation trembled violently; the demonic energy chains that had materialized were already beginning to dissolve. He looked up in terror. "Impossible! Why would the Heavenly Dao's Eye intervene—" Before he could finish, an invisible force completely erased the core of the formation beneath his feet.

Chen Ji's heart tightened. He had experienced the Heavenly Dao's Eye's will before—it was a cold existence that treated all prophets as chess pieces. But the force intervening now was clearly one dimension higher than the Heavenly Dao's Eye. What could it be? Fragments of what Mo Xiansheng once said flashed through his mind—"Above the Tianji Record, there are even older chess players."

In the instant the core of the forbidden formation was erased, Ling Yuan felt unprecedented backlash. The black demonic energy no longer obeyed his commands but instead began frantically corroding his meridians. He let out a pained howl; the dignified Sect Master of Tianqing Sect was now like a beast having its throat gripped by fate. "No... This is impossible! The forbidden power was a supreme treasure I obtained from the Holy Sect—how could it—"

dialogue.content: The Holy Sect gave it to you?

text.content: Chen Ji walked slowly toward Ling Yuan, the Fate Chessboard extending beneath his feet, each step landing on nodes of fate. He looked at the once high-and-mighty Sect Master now in such a wretched state, his eyes showing no sympathy. "Ling Yuan, do you think the Holy Sect would give you the complete inheritance of the forbidden formation?" He paused. "Because they needed a scapegoat, a fool to be sacrificed at a crucial moment."

Ling Yuan's face turned ashen. The forbidden power was rebounding, and he could feel it devouring his vitality, yet his body couldn't move an inch. The Fate Chessboard's power had him firmly locked in place. A dignified late-Yuanying cultivator was now meat on a chopping block. "You... did you know from the beginning?" he forced out, his voice hoarse, unrecognizable.

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan struggled to survive in the forbidden backlash, but it was already too late. He had exposed too much information—the Holy Sect's scheme, the truth of the forbidden formation, and his pitiful situation as an abandoned piece. Crush him completely, or deliberately leave him alive to lure out bigger fish?

choices.text: Send him on his way personally, leave no future troubles
choices.description: Place the final piece on the Fate Chessboard, completely ending Ling Yuan's vitality, letting him turn to dust with all his secrets.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the opportunity to extract more intelligence from Ling Yuan
choices.visible_reward: Ling Yuan dies, Sect Master position vacant, Tianqing Sect's landscape will be completely reshuffled
choices.risk_hint: May miss clues to the Holy Sect's follow-up schemes

text.content: Chen Ji didn't speak again. He raised his hand; the Forty-Nine piece rotated one final circle between his fingers, then gently landed on Ling Yuan's fontanel. In that moment, the entire Fate Chessboard illuminated. Brilliant light completely engulfed Ling Yuan's body.

dialogue.content: Go well, Sect Master. I hope in your next life, you won't let others use you as a chess piece.

choices.text: Spare his wretched life, lure out the Holy Sect
choices.description: Deliberately leave Ling Yuan alive, making him bait to draw out the Holy Sect's follow-up schemes, following the vine to find even greater enemies.
choices.visible_cost: Ling Yuan may counterattack at a critical moment, creating variables
choices.visible_reward: May obtain complete intelligence on the Holy Sect's schemes, even hooking out the Holy Sect's true chess player
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan's remnant forces may organize a rescue

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his piece. The Fate Chessboard's light收敛 into delicate patterns, coiling around Ling Yuan's body. That wasn't imprisonment, but marking—any existence attempting to approach Ling Yuan would be recorded by the chessboard's power. "Your life I'll collect first," he looked down at the dying Ling Yuan. "After I meet the Holy Sect's people, I'll come send you on your way."

dialogue.content: You... you dare... the Holy Sect will never let you off...

text.content: Ling Yuan's body trembled violently in the forbidden backlash, the torrential demonic energy devouring his final vitality. His eyes were full of disbelief—he who had schemed his entire life, calculated his entire life, was ultimately just an abandoned piece on someone else's chessboard. "Chen Ji..." his voice was hoarse like a broken bellows. "You think you've won? You're merely a chess piece in an even larger game... The Heavenly Dao's Eye... it will never let anyone truly win..."

Before the words finished, Ling Yuan's body suddenly froze. Black patterns spread from within him—signs of the forbidden power breaking free. He opened his mouth, wanting to say something, but only emitted a pained groan.紧接着, his body began swelling in a grotesque manner, blood vessels visible beneath skin now seemingly soaked in ink.

Chen Ji's pupils constricted. The changes occurring within Ling Yuan were all too familiar—this was the precursor to the forbidden power run amok. He made a decisive choice. The Fate Chessboard abruptly contracted, enveloping everyone within ten zhang in a defensive barrier. At the same time, he sharply turned toward Su Qingyao's direction. "Everyone, retreat!"

However, Ling Yuan's body swelled too quickly. In merely three breaths, his body had expanded to three times its original size. Those black patterns had covered his entire body, including his face. Now his expression showed no pain or fear, only an eerie calm, as if something was watching this world through his eyes.

dialogue.content: Finally... someone has opened this door.

text.content: That voice was no longer the cold will of the Heavenly Dao's Eye, but an existence far more ancient and primeval. It spoke through Ling Yuan's completely transformed body, each word carrying weight that made souls tremble. Chen Ji felt the Fate Chessboard he had arranged being corroded by some force—a force belonging to no law of this world.

Chen Ji gripped the Forty-Nine piece tightly, cold sweat sliding down his spine. His Tianji Record quivered frantically in his mind; Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul issued a string of urgent warnings, but he could no longer hear any of it. His entire concentration was on that cracking body—Ling Yuan's chest was tearing open, something was crawling out from within.

An eye. A pupil completely composed of darkness, a full zhang in diameter, embedded in Ling Yuan's torn-open chest. It slowly turned, scanning every person around. When that eye finally fixed on Chen Ji, he felt unprecedented pressure—not a threat to his flesh, but a gaze acting directly upon his soul.

So that's how it is. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in Chen Ji's mind, carrying a hint of bitter laughter. The Heavenly Dao's Eye is merely a gatekeeper, and the door you've opened leads to its master. Chen Ji, you should know the full name of the Tianji Record by now, right? Its original name was—" At this point, Mo Xiansheng's voice abruptly stopped, as if some force was preventing him from continuing.

Chen Ji had no time to pursue the eye's origins. The vertical pupil made of darkness had fully opened. Ling Yuan's remnant body shed like a snake, a new existence breaking free from within. It had no fixed form, merely a constantly writhing mass of darkness, plus that eye radiating ancient aura. Chen Ji knew—the true test had just begun.
